verses.verse:
तर्जनीं च समुत्थाप्य तूर्यो नादो निनाद्यते।
अथानामिकामन्या मुत्थाप्यैव च पंचमः।८४।
verses.text: By lifting the index finger the fourth sound is sounded; then, by lifting the other ring finger, the fifth.

commentary.text: That is, lifting the anāmikā, that is, the third finger, of the other hand produces the pañcama (fifth) note. But keep in mind that, as soon as that finger is lifted, the ring finger of the first hand, which was already raised, should be put back on its own hole. Otherwise, once all the fingers are lifted, the bānsurī will have no support and may fall to the ground.

subsection.title: Practice of the Tongue and of the Fingers
